question.text: The Annual Impact Report of a listed SE must be filed under SEBI LODR Regulations under which specific Regulation dealing with SSE-specific continuous disclosures?

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook pages 210-211 and the current official SEBI LODR (pages 148-149) place the SSE-specific Annual Impact Report submission under Regulation 91E. Regulation 91E is the SSE continuous-disclosure provision that requires the AIR to be filed, which is why it is the correct citation here. The Trap: Regulation 27 covers corporate governance, Regulation 30 covers disclosure of material events, and Regulation 33 covers financial results. A candidate who has only skimmed LODR may pick one of these general regulations without spotting that the AIR is filed under the SSE-specific Regulation 91E. Note: Any earlier framing of this requirement as 'Regulation 33 Part VII' is not supported by the current official LODR text and has been corrected to Regulation 91E.
